verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's marketing pages describe its own automation features: automating recurring fixes, automated remediation across endpoints in DEX Essentials, and having the Tia AI agent build new automations to predict, prevent and fix IT issues. These suggest background automations, but the evidence is thin marketing copy with no detail on how users configure them or how they trigger or run. Remote script execution, a one-off action, is not counted as a recurring schedule. Missing for 10: documentation of user-configurable automation setup, schedules or triggers, evidence the automations run autonomously in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Reduce manual workload by automating recurring fixes.
DEX Essentials helps IT teams stay ahead of issues with real-time visibility, actionable insights, and automated remediation across endpoints.
help Tia build new automations to cut digital friction and time-wasting repetitive tasks
Tia, your AI agent, learns from every support session to predict, prevent, and rapidly fix IT issues.
